options.name: Progression Balancing
options.doc:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.

options.name: Death Link
options.doc:
When you die, everyone who enabled death link dies. Of course, the reverse is true too.
This manifests itself in exploding rides. Somebody dying will cause a random ride to crash, and building rides badly will cause others to die.
There's a 20 second timer between deathlink events. Fix that coaster quickly!
This option can be enabled/disabled in game as well by typing !!toggledeathlink in the chat tab of the unlock shop.

This option can be enabled/disabled in game as well by typing !!toggledeathlink in the chat tab of the unlock shop.
options.doc_fr:
Quand vous mourez, tous ceux qui ont permis la mort meurent. Bien sûr, l'inverse est vrai aussi.
Cela se manifeste par l'explosion des manèges. Quelqu'un qui meurt va causer un accident au hasard, et construire des manèges va causer la mort d'autres.
Il y a 20 secondes entre les événements liés à la mort. Répare ce sous-verre vite !
Cette option peut être activée/désactivée dans le jeu aussi bien en tapant !!toggledeathlink dans l'onglet chat de la boutique de déverrouillage.

options.name: Scenario Length

Synchronous Long: Around 4 hours to complete.
Lengthy: Recommended for Asyncs.
Marathon: Recommended for Asyncs.
